# uzc_affinity_groups (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud affinity groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_affinity_groups" "all" {}

output "affinity_group_slugs" {
  value = [for g in data.uzc_affinity_groups.all.affinity_groups : g.slug]
}
```
